improve.title: Defensive work rate
tips: As a CDM/CM, screen the back line: stay between the ball and our goal and pick off passes.
When the ball is lost, the nearest player presses and everyone else closes the passing lanes.
Make yourself big in the box when they shoot. Blocks count, even if the stats don't.
improve.coach: It's shown up in 60% of your matches and it's holding steady. Let's crack it.

improve.title: Forcing passes
tips: Below about 72% the extra passes start costing us. Pick the simple option until the touch comes back.
If nothing's on, keep it: shield, turn back, let the shape reset. Patience is a pass too.
A sideways pass that keeps the ball is worth more than a forward one that loses it.
improve.coach: Flagged 32% of the time overall, 20% in your last five. That's a trend I like.

strengths.title: Goal threat
strengths.coach: That ball had your name on it from the moment you set your feet. 64% of the time. Teammates can count on it.

strengths.title: Chance creation
strengths.coach: Making your teammates look good is the most generous thing in football. Shows up in 48% of your matches. That's a calling card.

strengths.title: On-ball involvement
strengths.note: Heavily involved; the team plays through them.
strengths.coach: You were more involved than a church bake-sale committee. There in 44% of your matches. Build your game around it.

coach.intro: BellyTb1, 25 matches is enough to see who you are as a player. I like what I see, and I see where we can go.
